sections.p: This website is operated by Sivan Menahem Management, Plateia Eleftherias 2, 73132 Chania, Greece (the “controller”). Contact: support@sivanmanagment.com.

When you submit a form, we collect the details you provide: name, email, phone number, property information and your message. We also record technical data needed to protect the form against abuse, such as the time of submission and the page you came from. If you accept analytics, we collect anonymous, aggregated usage statistics.

We use your data to respond to your request, prepare a proposal and, if you become a client, to perform our agreement. The legal bases are your consent and the steps taken at your request before entering into a contract (Art. 6(1)(a) and (b) GDPR).
Your data is stored in our customer-management tools (such as Airtable) and our property-management system, operated by processors bound by data-processing agreements. We do not sell your data.
Some processors may store data outside the European Economic Area. Where this happens, transfers are covered by appropriate safeguards such as the EU Standard Contractual Clauses.
Enquiries that do not lead to an agreement are deleted within 24 months. Client data is kept for as long as required by our agreement and by Greek tax and accounting law.

You can request access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability or object to processing, and withdraw consent at any time, by emailing support@sivanmanagment.com. You may also complain to the Hellenic Data Protection Authority (www.dpa.gr).
We store your cookie choice and language preference in your browser. These are necessary for the site to work and do not track you.
Only if you accept, we may load privacy-friendly analytics to understand how the site is used. No advertising cookies are used.
You can change your choice at any time by clearing this site's data in your browser; the banner will then appear again.
This website presents the services of Sivan Menahem Management. The information is general and does not constitute an offer, or legal, tax or investment advice.
Any estimates of rental performance are indicative. We do not guarantee income, occupancy or property values. Services are provided only under a signed written agreement.
Some images on this website are illustrative, including AI-generated images, and do not depict properties under our management unless stated.
Text, design and logos on this website belong to Sivan Menahem Management or their licensors. Third-party trademarks belong to their owners.
These terms are governed by Greek law. The courts of Chania have jurisdiction, without prejudice to mandatory consumer-protection rules.
